name: com.cyaim.im
description: Client SDK for Cyaim IM Cloud. Multiplexed WebSocket with a typed surface over conn/msg/conv/user/friend/group/media/push, full-jitter reconnect, kick handling, in-place token renewal, offline push registration, and a durable two-cursor model that repairs gaps across a process restart instead of silently skipping them. Callbacks are marshalled to the Unity main thread, and WebGL is supported through a browser WebSocket transport.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour that connects, persists its cursors, registers for offline push, renders incoming messages, and fetches a user token from your own backend.
